--- create_search_index_order_by_interleave_column_last.sql
-- a column named INTERLEAVE as the last ORDER BY key, no INTERLEAVE IN clause
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex
ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens)
PARTITION BY SingerId
ORDER BY ReleaseTimestamp DESC, INTERLEAVE
--- AST
&ast.CreateSearchIndex{
  Create: 79,
  Name:   &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 99,
        NameEnd: 110,
        Name:    "AlbumsIndex",
      },
    },
  },
  TableName: &ast.Path{
    Idents: []*ast.Ident{
      &ast.Ident{
        NamePos: 114,
        NameEnd: 120,
        Name:    "Albums",
      },
    },
  },
  TokenListPart: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 121,
      NameEnd: 138,
      Name:    "AlbumTitle_Tokens",
    },
  },
  Rparen:           138,
  PartitionColumns: []*ast.Ident{
    &ast.Ident{
      NamePos: 153,
      NameEnd: 161,
      Name:    "SingerId",
    },
  },
  OrderBy: &ast.OrderBy{
    Order: 162,
    Items: []*ast.OrderByItem{
      &ast.OrderByItem{
        DirPos: 188,
        Expr:   &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 171,
          NameEnd: 187,
          Name:    "ReleaseTimestamp",
        },
        Dir: "DESC",
      },
      &ast.OrderByItem{
        DirPos: -1,
        Expr:   &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 194,
          NameEnd: 204,
          Name:    "INTERLEAVE",
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
CREATE SEARCH INDEX AlbumsIndex ON Albums(AlbumTitle_Tokens) PARTITION BY SingerId ORDER BY ReleaseTimestamp DESC, INTERLEAVE
